newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT--Dlr seen trading sideways pre-FOMC.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT--Dlr seen trading sideways pre-FOMC.

text.p: The meeting of the Federal Market Committee on Tuesday is a guarantee of more near-term sideways trading for the dollar, analysts said on Friday.
The market has priced a 25-basis-point hike in the 5.25-percent federal funds rate, but traders and analysts agreed the impact on the dollar of such a hike is unclear.
The dollar came under heavy selling pressure when the Federal Reserve last tightened credit in 1994-early 1995.
In late trading, the dollar was quoted at 1.6860/65 marks versus 1.6925/35 at the close on Thursday, and at 122.65/70 yen vs 123.70/75.
"It was not a totally dark, destructive day," I.D.E.A. analyst Ben Morden said of the dollar's setbacks on Friday.
"Dollar/Swiss closed higher, and mark/Swiss is very constructive," added Morden who noted "mark/Swiss strength usually implies strength for the dollar."
Dollar/Swiss franc ended at 1.4570/80, up from 1.4530/40 on Thursday, while mark/Swiss climbed to 0.8640 from 0.8583.
"But it would be tough to break through resistance at 1.4620 Swiss francs before the FOMC meeting," Morden admitted.
Analysts said dollar/Swiss, often a leader, will remain "cautiously bullish" until 1.4690 resistance is taken out.
Analysts said if dollar/mark retains momentum, possibly helped by dollar/Swiss, a test of 1.7120 and 1.7210 -- the high on March 7 -- may be in the cards.
On dollar/yen, analysts noted the U.S. currency held above key support in the 122-to-121.80 area indicates the upside is still intact. These levels are key in a four-month uptrend line.
Aside from the FOMC meeting, dollar/yen may also be affected by the end of the Japanese fiscal year next week. But a bull run would require revisiting 124.82 -- the high on February 14.
Meanwhile, mark/yen struggled around 72.85 key support -- an indication 73.30/35 topped the recovery from a recent low at 70.48 on March 7.
Analysts agreed the dollar, helped by the U.S. interest rate outlook, is the leader in this fresh rally which should cap mark/yen strength between 72.80 and 73.30.
